podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: The Doughboys Formation (c. 1987)
podcast.body: The band was formed in Montreal around 1987 by John Kastner, though their initial five years were unproductive and spent "spinning their wheels." "They were born in Montreal in about 1987, formed by a guy named John Casner, and for the first five years, they spun their wheels."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Rise in 1993
podcast.body: Doo Boys began their rise in 1993, joining a wave of new Canadian artists gaining attention both domestically and internationally. This marked a period when foreign music fans started discovering Canadian talent. "1993, Doe Boys, the Tea Party, Daniel Landwaw, More Sarah McLaughlin, More Pursuit of Happiness, More Cowboy Junkeys."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Roots of the 90s CanRock Explosion

podcast.title: Early 1990s Prime Time Success
podcast.body: Doughboys were among the Canadian bands that got "a shot at prime time" in the early 1990s. "There was Pluto and Jail and Doeboys and Rusty and Sloan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: John Kastner's Marriage
podcast.body: John Kastner married actress Jessica Paré, known for her role as Megan Draper in the series *Mad Men*, and they have a son together. "He also ended up marrying actress Jessica Parre. She played Megan Draper, Don Draper's wife in the series Mad Men? They have a son together."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: John Kastner's Post-Doughboys Career
podcast.body: John Kastner transitioned into a career as a composer for film and television. "leader John Casner became a composer for film and TV."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Jonathan Cummings' Post-Doughboys Career
podcast.body: Guitarist Jonathan Cummings became a music writer after his time with the band. "Guitarist Jonathan Cummings became a music writer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Montreal Origins and Offspring Tour
podcast.body: The Doughboys originated from Montreal, Canada, and notably toured with The Offspring during the period of massive success for their album *Smash*. "And then we have Montreal's Doe Boys. They even toured with the offspring during the crazy days of Smash."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Paul Newman's Post-Doughboys Career
podcast.body: Drummer Paul Newman went on to work as a member of Coldplay's road crew. "Last I heard drummer Paul Newman worked as one of Coldplay's road crew."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Scott McCullough's Departure and Rusty Formation
xref.body: Scott McCullough, who was the original guitarist for The Doughboys, left that band early on to establish his own group, Rusty. "Scott McCullough was the original guitarist for the group, but he left early on to form his own band called Rusty."
